scenes.title: CAN OUR SUN BECOME A BLACK HOLE?
scenes.say: Can our Sun become a black hole?

scenes.title: PAUSE AND GUESS
scenes.say: Yes someday, no it's too light, or only if it explodes? Pause and guess.
It's B. Our Sun is too light. It would need about twenty times more mass.
Our Sun: one sun heavy. A star that can become a black hole: about twenty.

scenes.title: It swells into a red giant
scenes.say: In about five billion years, the Sun runs low on fuel and swells into a red giant. It might even swallow Earth.

scenes.title: Then it shrinks. A lot.
scenes.say: Then it shrinks into a tiny, glowing leftover called a white dwarf.

scenes.label: years until the Sun is a white dwarf
scenes.say: That takes about six billion years. So relax.

scenes.title: WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU FALL INTO A BLACK HOLE?
scenes.say: What happens if you fall into a black hole? A, you burn. B, you stretch. C, you freeze. Answer in part three.
